request_payload.title: Discovery of Functionalized 1H-Benzo[d]imidazoles That Confer Protective Effects in a Phenotypic CLN3 Disease Patient-Derived iPSC Model.

mentions.sentence: Novel 1H-benzo[d]imidazoles that do not incur this metabolic liability are reported that possess enhanced protective effects in a highly phenotypic CLN3 patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) model.

candidates.label: Cannabidiol (plant-derived, pharmaceutical)
candidates.summary: A purified cannabidiol oral solution with an FDA label covering seizures associated with Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Laronidase (enzyme replacement for MPS I)

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

candidates.label: Eliglustat (substrate reduction)
candidates.summary: An oral drug that slows production of the lipid that builds up in Gaucher disease (substrate reduction).

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Gaucher disease (imiglucerase, velaglucerase alfa, taliglucerase alfa)

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Fabry disease (agalsidase beta, pegunigalsidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of alpha-galactosidase A for people with Fabry disease.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Pompe disease (alglucosidase alfa, avalglucosidase alfa, cipaglucosidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of acid alpha-glucosidase, the only disease-specific treatment class for Pompe disease.

candidates.label: Idursulfase (enzyme replacement for MPS II)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant iduronate-2-sulfatase for Hunter syndrome (MPS II).

candidates.label: Olipudase alfa (enzyme replacement for ASMD)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant acid sphingomyelinase, approved only for the non-brain manifestations of ASMD.

candidates.label: Atidarsagene autotemcel (stem-cell gene therapy for MLD)

mentions.sentence: Selected lead compounds 9b and 38b afforded significant protective effect and reduced phenotypic hallmarks of CLN3 pathology while also possessing "drug-like" pharmacokinetics.

candidates.label: Stiripentol
candidates.summary: An anti-seizure medicine with an FDA label for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome in patients taking clobazam.

candidates.label: Haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (early, for Krabbe disease)
candidates.summary: Donor blood stem cells that supply galactocerebrosidase. The only disease-modifying option for Krabbe disease, and only effective when done very early.

candidates.label: Statins (lovastatin, simvastatin) for RASopathy cognition

candidates.label: KCNT1-targeting antisense oligonucleotide (knockdown)
candidates.summary: Antisense oligonucleotides that lower KCNT1 expression; tested in mice and given investigationally to two infants.

candidates.label: Scn8a-lowering antisense oligonucleotide (preclinical)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers Scn8a; protective in mouse models of SCN8A encephalopathy and of Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

candidates.label: Miglustat (substrate reduction; also an enzyme stabilizer)

candidates.label: Zorevunersen (STK-001, SCN1A TANGO antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide designed to raise productive SCN1A (NaV1.1) expression; in phase 3 for Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Elsunersen (PRAX-222, SCN2A-targeting antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers SCN2A expression, studied in early-onset gain-of-function SCN2A DEE.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Pompe disease (alglucosidase alfa, avalglucosidase alfa, cipaglucosidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of acid alpha-glucosidase, the only disease-specific treatment class for Pompe disease.
